approach.en: Grow the window on the right until it covers every needed tag, then shrink it from the left for as long as it still covers them: each covering window is measured, and the shortest one is the answer.

caption.en: needed = "BOK": missing starts with the count of each tag needed, and to_cover = 3 volumes are still lacking.
caption.ko: needed = "BOK": missing에는 태그마다 필요한 수가 들어가고, 아직 모자란 권수는 to_cover = 3입니다.

items.why: to_cover is how many needed volumes the window still lacks, summed over the cards; it is no one card's value, only equal to one by chance
